title: Design System: La Feuille de Blanmont

brand.usage: Route red, the club colour, calibrated for UI: primary buttons, active tabs, live dots, focus ring, caret, selection. White on it 4.75:1; on paper 4.58:1. Never a broad wash.

brand-strong.usage: Hover/pressed of brand, red text on brand-tint (5.4:1), prose links.

brand-vif.usage: Map road red and the Heart Line mark. Large fields and strokes only: 4.1:1 on paper is below AA for small text.

brand-tint.usage: Crimson wash behind brand/danger badges and admin-danger buttons. Text on it: brand-strong.

brand-soft.usage: Red lettering on night sheets (7.6:1 on night). Fails on paper (2.4:1): night only.

bistre.usage: Relief bistre: contours, elevation, gravel. As text 3.9:1 on paper (large only); use bistre-ink for small text.

bistre-soft.usage: Light bistre for elevation fills and profiles.

hydro.usage: Hydro blue: rivers, wind vectors, GPX tracks, weather. 5.0:1 on paper.

hydro-soft.usage: Light hydro for water fills and charts.

vert.usage: Woodland green: Carré Vert, attendance, validated rides, vert cartouche. White on it 5.1:1.

vert-strong.usage: Success badge text on vert-tint (6.2:1), vert cartouche on night.

bois.usage: Bois de Buis woodland tint: forest fills, Carré Vert chip ground (vert text on it 4.1:1: use vert-strong for small text).

ambre.usage: Amber: warnings, secondary roads, detours. Never text on paper (2.3:1); fine as text on night (8.0:1).

jaune.usage: Map yellow, sparing highlight on map layers.

paper.usage: Day map paper: the base ground of every day sheet.

paper-2.usage: Recessed survey ground: chips, tabular cells, scrollbar track.

white.usage: Lettering on red, green and blue fills; day panels (bg-white) and inputs.

line.usage: Day 1px hairline (neatlines, dividers). Decorative only: 1.3:1 on paper, never a control border alone.

line-strong.usage: Day high-contrast divider, card hover border, scrollbar thumb.

ink.usage: Printed black: headings, primary text, scale-bar segments, outline buttons.

ink-3.usage: Muted ink: captions, coordinates, legend terms (6.1:1 on paper).

night-2.usage: Raised night panel, cards, inactive pills on night.

night-3.usage: Recessed night cells, inputs on night, ghost hover.

night-line-strong.usage: Night high-contrast divider, legend borders in the nuit cartouche.

snow-2.usage: Night body copy, scale-strip ink on night.

snow-3.usage: Night muted lettering, neatline and tick ink on night (7.5:1 on night).

roleTokens.name: surface
roleTokens.usage: Page ground. Code pairing: bg-paper dark:bg-night.

roleTokens.name: surface-raised
roleTokens.usage: Panels set on the ground: cartouche panel, empty state, inputs, inactive pills. Code: bg-white dark:bg-night-2 (cards also use bg-paper dark:bg-night-2).

roleTokens.name: surface-recessed
roleTokens.usage: Recessed cells: chips, table cells, ghost-button hover, legends. Code: bg-paper-2 dark:bg-night-3.

roleTokens.name: rule
roleTokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: card borders, dividers, legend rows. Code: border-line dark:border-night-line (the most used pair in the app).

roleTokens.name: rule-strong
roleTokens.usage: Hover border on cards, borders between major sections.

roleTokens.name: text
roleTokens.usage: Headings and primary lettering. 17.2:1 on surface (day), 16.8:1 (night). Code: text-ink dark:text-snow.

roleTokens.name: text-body
roleTokens.usage: Running copy and descriptions. 10.1:1 on paper, 12.2:1 on night.

roleTokens.name: text-muted
roleTokens.usage: Captions, coordinates, legend terms, sheet margin. 6.1:1 on paper, 7.5:1 on night.

roleTokens.name: text-accent
roleTokens.usage: Red lettering: links, active tab, live labels. 4.58:1 on paper (AA), only 4.18:1 on paper-2: use brand-strong there. brand-soft is 7.6:1 on night.

roleTokens.name: on-brand
roleTokens.usage: Lettering on a brand or brand-strong fill (4.75:1 and 6.1:1). Also on vert (5.1:1) and hydro (5.1:1).

roleTokens.name: focus-ring
roleTokens.usage: Global :focus-visible outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, in both themes.

roleTokens.name: neat
roleTokens.usage: Ink of the neatline frame (CSS var --neat in globals.css).

roleTokens.name: strip
roleTokens.usage: Ink of the graduated scale strip (CSS var --strip).

roleTokens.name: tick
roleTokens.usage: Corner-tick ink (CSS var --tick; components set dark:[--tick:var(--color-snow-3)]).

mapLayers.name: map-grid
mapLayers.usage: Kilometric grid printed over the sheet (2 km cells).

mapLayers.name: map-halo
mapLayers.usage: Paper glow behind map labels (map-label utility).

display.purpose: SheetHeader title: wide 125%, extra-bold, uppercase, one per page, max 20ch.

headline.purpose: Section headlines: semiwide 112.5%, extra-bold, uppercase. No eyebrow above.

title.purpose: Route names, card, drawer and dialog titles.

label.purpose: Badges, table headers, legend terms, coordinates: narrow 87.5%, uppercase, 0.08em (legend terms 11px, 0.12em).

telemetry.purpose: Every cycling metric: tabular figures, unit with a non-breaking space, French decimal comma.

fontStretch.name: stretch-semiwide
fontStretch.purpose: Headlines, legend values, map labels, prose headings.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Cartouche panel over the map band.

motion.name: ease-plot
motion.purpose: Plotting: sheet develop, route draw, compass turn, pulse ring.

motion.name: ease-stamp
motion.purpose: Stamp-in of badges and markers, wordmark hover.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour transitions on controls; buttons press 1px down.

motion.name: duration-develop
motion.purpose: The territory sheet developing outward from the Place de la Féchère (ease-plot).

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Cartouche splits into title and legend columns; 32px gutter.

narrative.northStar: La Feuille de Blanmont — Carte IGN
narrative.overview:
The CC Saint-Martin Blanmont platform is printed like a topographic sheet of the club's own territory: a 32 km square centred on the Place de la Féchère in Blanmont (50°37′23″ N · 4°38′32″ E), with its 5 m contours, the Dyle, the railway and the woods of the Bois de Buis. Map paper, black Archivo lettering and the map's spot inks, each ink with a geographic meaning. It is a club document members read before and after a ride, not a SaaS dashboard.

Two sheets carry the whole interface. The day sheet is map paper (#fbfbf8) with black lettering; the night sheet is a deep ink ground (#0d1013) with snow lettering, and the territory map reprints itself in darker inks by night. Structure comes from print devices, not from shadows: 1px hairlines, the neatline of the cartouche, registration corner ticks, the graduated scale strip and the 2 km kilometric grid. Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width axis rather than from extra faces or tracking.

Density follows the map: key facts sit in a legend beside the title, metrics are tabular and carry their units, and pages are composed like a map sheet with varied spans rather than rows of identical cards. All copy is French, plain and sporty: the place, the distance, the time.
keyCharacteristics: Every public page opens with the `SheetHeader` cartouche over a band of the real territory, key facts in its legend.
Two grounds only (day paper, night sheet) written as day/night role pairs; never a mid-tone grey or a third ground.
Spot inks with a meaning: route red for the one action and live state, bistre for relief, hydro for water and wind, vert for Carré Vert and attendance, ambre for warnings.
Archivo variable font, hierarchy on the width axis: wide (125%) display, semiwide (112.5%) headlines, narrow (87.5%) labels, badges and buttons.
Printed frames (hairline, neatline, corner ticks, scale strip, map grid), crisp 2–6px corners, flat at rest.
Every cycling metric in tabular figures with its unit, French number format ("84,5 km", "720 m D+", "26,0 km/h").

rules.name: The Role Pair Rule
rules.body: Every surface, rule and text colour is written as a day/night pair: `surface` = `bg-paper dark:bg-night`, `surface-raised` = `bg-white dark:bg-night-2`, `surface-recessed` = `bg-paper-2 dark:bg-night-3`, `rule` = `border-line dark:border-night-line`, `text` = `text-ink dark:text-snow`, `text-body` = `text-ink-2 dark:text-snow-2`, `text-muted` = `text-ink-3 dark:text-snow-3`, `text-accent` = `text-brand dark:text-brand-soft`. A day class without its night pair, or a pair naming a token that does not exist, is a bug.

rules.name: The Spot Ink Rule
rules.body: Each ink means one thing on the map and in the UI (red road and action, bistre relief, hydro water and weather, vert woods and attendance, ambre warning). No decorative gradients, pastels or SaaS blues and purples.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Route Red marks the one action a view is for and live state. It is never a broad background wash; washes use Crimson Wash behind red lettering.

rules.name: The Small Text Ink Rule
rules.body: Small text never uses Road Red Vif, Amber, Night Red on paper, or Relief Bistre on paper: use Route Red Strong, Amber Ink, Bistre Ink and Deep Woodland.

rules.name: The Width-Over-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is set with `font-wide`, `font-semiwide`, `font-narrow` and `font-condensed`, not with stretched letter-spacing or a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every cycling metric (km, m D+, km/h, splits, counts in legends) uses `tabular-nums`, its unit and French number format: decimal comma, non-breaking space before the unit ("84,5 km").

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No uppercase kicker or eyebrow above a headline. The sheet name belongs in the cartouche margin ("Feuille · Calendrier"), not above the title.

rules.name: The Map Sheet Rule
rules.body: Never compose a page from rows of identical cards. Vary spans, pair a map with its table, and put the key facts in a legend.

rules.name: The Touch Target Rule
rules.body: Controls reach 44px on phones: buttons are 44px tall below 640px (40px above), filter pills use the lg size.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A container declares its elevation once: a 1px `rule` frame at rest, or a shadow because it is raised. Never a wide soft shadow under a bordered card.

rules.name: The Printed Frame Rule
rules.body: Frames are printed: `neatline` for the cartouche and heroes, `corner-ticks` for callouts and empty states, `scale-strip` under the masthead, `map-grid` over map bands. One framing device per box. No glassmorphism, backdrop blur or glow.

rules.name: The Sheet Corner Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, cards and panels stay between 2px and 6px; a pill-shaped button or card is off-system.

dos: **Do** write every user-facing string in idiomatic French, verb first on actions ("Télécharger le GPX", "S'inscrire"), no exclamation marks, no emoji.
**Do** write colours as role pairs that exist in `app/globals.css`: `bg-paper dark:bg-night`, `border-line dark:border-night-line`, `text-ink-3 dark:text-snow-3`.
**Do** open every public page with `SheetHeader` and put its key facts in the legend.
**Do** set every metric in `tabular-nums` with its unit and French number format ("84,5 km", "720 m D+", "26,0 km/h", "08:30").
**Do** frame with 1px hairlines, the neatline or corner ticks, one device per box.
**Do** keep one primary red button per view and make every control 44px tall on phones.
**Do** say what happened and the next step in empty and error states ("Aucune sortie prévue cette semaine. Proposez un parcours.").
**Do** parse dates in Europe/Brussels and stop every animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** hard-code hex values or inline styles in components; use the tokens of `app/globals.css`.
**Don't** use a token that does not exist (`dark:text-snow-1`): the element keeps its day colour by night.
**Don't** use glassmorphism, backdrop blur, blur halos, glows or gradient text; surfaces are flat paper or night sheet.
**Don't** use Poppins, Inter, Roboto or any second face; Archivo is the only family.
**Don't** round buttons, inputs or cards beyond 6px or into pills; `rounded-full` is for chips and pills only.
**Don't** set small text in Road Red Vif, Amber, Night Red or Relief Bistre on paper; use Route Red Strong, Amber Ink, Bistre Ink, Deep Woodland.
**Don't** spread Route Red as a background wash or add a second primary action.
**Don't** place an eyebrow label above a headline or build a page from rows of identical cards or hero-metric tiles.
